sentences.text:
On 02.05.2023, the prosecutrix went to Madhva Mata alongwith co-accused Chanda,
thereafter, the main accused Balu Gurjar also went to Madhva Mata and the co-accused persons Chanda and Balu Gurjar took the prosecutrix at Jodhpur.
The co-accused persons kept her in a hut and Balu Gurjar committed rape with her.
03. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has not committed the offence and has falsely been implicated in the case.
He further submits that the name of the present applicant is not mentioned in the statement of prosecutrix which is recorded under Section 161 and 164 of the Cr.P.C.
He has been implicated in the case only on the statement of co-accused Balu which is recorded under Section 27 of the Evidence Act.
The present applicant is in custody since 26.05.2023.
Investigation is pending and the trial of the case will take sufficient long time on which grounds prayer has made to enlarged the applicant on bail.
04. On the other hand, learned Government Advocate for the non- applicant/State has objected the prayer and prayed for rejection of the application.
05. The prosecutrix is absent despite service of notice.

06. Having considered the rival submissions of learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case so also the fact that trial of this case will take sufficient long time, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail,
hence, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.
07.

It is directed that applicant- Maansingh shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) alongwith one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court, for his appearance before the concerned Court regularly on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during trial.

It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C.
08.
With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
